item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
MacBroom 1.0.1 — Performance Update 🚀

  • 🚀 Native macOS APIs — 10x faster system monitoring
  • 🔧 Storage now matches About This Mac (decimal GB)
  • 🗑️ New scan targets: Mail Downloads, system logs, browser caches
  • 📊 Accurate disk size calculation (physical usage)
  • 🛡️ Improved safety rules for browser data

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
MacBroom 1.0.0 — First Release! 🎉

  • 🧹 Smart Clean — Clean cache, logs, trash, and more
  • 📁 Large Files — Find and delete large files
  • 📊 Disk Analyzer — Visual disk usage with system skip
  • ⚡ Free Up RAM — Memory optimization with live monitoring
  • 🗑️ App Uninstaller — Remove apps completely
  • 📈 System Monitor — CPU, RAM, Network, Storage
  • 📋 Menu Bar — Quick stats and actions
